d:
What does it take to challenge expectations, carve your own path and create meaningful change? In a conversation spanning leadership, ambition, identity and purpose, Arundhati Bhattacharya and Sanjana Sanghi explore what it means to go beyond the script — navigating unconventional career journeys, embracing courage and using influence to make a difference.
Moderator: Abhishek Singh, Associate Editor, LiveMint
Speakers:
Arundhati Bhattacharya, President & CEO, Salesforce South Asia
Sanjana Sanghi, Actor & UNDP Youth Champion
Moderated by Abhishek Singh, Associate Editor, LiveMint
